query: Here is our draft chain: Inputs: $200k funding; Activities: Build court scheduling portal; Outputs: Faster court hearing access; Outcomes: Modernized court system. Refine this into a validated logic model.
expected_behavior: Detects that 'Build court scheduling portal' is an activity that produces an output (portal deployed), not an outcome itself
Detects that 'Faster court hearing access' was incorrectly labelled as an output when it is actually an outcome (intermediate outcome)
Separates outputs from immediate, intermediate, and long-term outcomes using the 7-stage canonical sequence
Generates a BC Gov-styled Mermaid flowchart and structured results matrix

query: Create an extended Theory of Change for an AI document summarization initiative for court trial coordinators.
expected_behavior: Distinguishes technology deployment (output/enabler) from operational time savings (intermediate outcome) and public justice access (long-term contribution)
Explicitly articulates assumptions (zero model hallucination, privacy compliance) and external factors (judicial directions)
Includes target population and beneficiary definitions
Employs backward design from long-term public value to necessary prerequisites

query: Generate a measurement-ready results framework / logframe for a digital public service modernization project.
expected_behavior: Populates indicators, baselines, targets, means of verification, and critical assumptions across all results tiers
Ensures each output has a designated user group and verifiable delivery acceptance criterion
Applies B.C. Government plain-language guidelines and sentence case
